statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of underlying sick sinus syndrome and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
A 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study was ordered
The service was rendered under CPT code 93247
The diagnosis codes are I49.5, I48.91, and I49.9
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on required precertification or prior authorization not being obtained before the service was rendered
